test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In any economy, the income velocity of the hoarded money (idle) by the public is equal to _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**zero**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** income velocity of money is a measure of the frequency at which the average unit of currency is used for transactions** in a given time period.
 
• When money is hoarded (idle), it is not being used for transactions.
 
• Hence, **the income velocity of hoarded money is zero because it does not circulate in the economy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The concept of money velocity is central to the quantity theory of money, which relates the money supply to the price level and the economy's output.
 
• A higher velocity of money indicates that each unit of currency is used more frequently to purchase goods and services within a given period.
 
• Conversely, a lower velocity can indicate economic stagnation or a preference for holding cash rather than spending.
